issues.issue: Did the officer err in finding the marriage was entered into in bad faith under section 4 of the IRPR?
issues.applicant_position: Officer relied on a few trivial inconsistencies and ignored strong evidence of a genuine, cohabiting marriage; applicant never got to answer the concerns.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, I find that it was open to the officer to deem the marriage not bona fide as set out in section 4 of the IRPR
